brief: Distinguish collateral at risk from the amount originally borrowed.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "What is pledged?"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "¿Qué queda en garantía?"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "O que fica em garantia?"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Distinguish collateral at risk from the amount originally borrowed.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A pledged asset can be at risk even when its value exceeds the loan.
instruction.misconception: Collateral means the borrowed cash or limits every possible loss to the original loan amount.
instruction.numeracy_support: Every quantity and assumption needed to decide is visible in the current scenario. Examples explain the relationship before independent application.

evidence.reasoning: A vehicle secures a loan. The borrowed amount is principal; the vehicle is collateral, subject to the agreement’s enforcement terms.
The bicycle is the asset pledged to secure repayment.
The clause identifies the machine as the asset at risk.
The debt amount and pledged asset are different concepts.
Higher value does not itself remove the contractual pledge.
The excerpt does not establish treatment of any remaining debt.
The agreement names work equipment as collateral for this loan.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
